messages:
Samir (Sales): transferring Newport Health (midmarket) to CS. Quick summary: 50-seat pilot, SSO + HIPAA required, POC ends 2026-04-30. Observed low usage first week and intermittent latency spikes (300-600ms) during peak. Primary contact: Karen Li <karen@newport.com>. Legal flagged DPA. Sending account notes + sample logs.
Priya (CS): thanks @Samir — I'll own the kickoff. Scheduling 30-min intro next Mon (3/30) with Karen and their infra lead. Can you drop the SSO/SCIM test creds and the exact time window for those latency spikes? Also assign me if you haven't already.
Samir (Sales): creds and sample logs uploaded to the shared folder: https://redwood.app/drive/newport/onboarding_notes.xlsx. Spikes seen 10:20-11:15 PST on 3/18 — attached request ids and traces.
Jordan (Support): creating support ticket for log access & initial triage. Ticket SUP-4389 created and assigned to me. Needs: sample request IDs (Samir provided), reproduction steps, and whether they're on hosted vs dedicated. ETA 48h for initial analysis.
Ava (Eng): @Jordan @Priya noted. I'll take perf triage if we can reproduce. Ask customer to run this quick load: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d @sample_prompt.json` capturing `x-req-id`. Suspect KV cache misses and model version mismatch (they may be on an older quantized build). If it's private deploy variant, different config required.
Priya (CS): update — I confirmed they are on hosted API but plan to move to Dedicated later this year. Next steps that I'm owning:
1) Kickoff meeting (invite sent) — owner: Priya
2) Support ticket SUP-4389 — owner: Jordan
3) Eng perf triage & perf test — owner: Ava
4) Confirm DPA & compliance checklist — owner: Priya + Legal
5) Customer enablement session + training workbook — owner: Priya
6) Weekly health readout & feedback capture — owner: Priya
Priya (CS): onboarding checklist (short):
```
- Confirm DPA signed
- SSO (SAML) test account + SCIM provisioning
- Provide sample prompt set + traffic pattern
- Send sample request IDs for spikes
- Schedule 1:1 enablement session (30m)
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency <250ms, >3k tokens/day baseline
- Weekly sync (first 4 weeks)
```
Samir (Sales): noted. Legal already has the DPA draft, I'll loop in Karen to sign this week.
Jordan (Support): SUP-4389 update: collected traces, reproduced 1.2x higher tail latency in staging under synthetic load. Assigned to Ava for deep dive. Logged runbook link: https://redwood.app/runbooks/perf-triage
Ava (Eng): initial find — KV cache eviction pattern seen at 1.5k concurrent sessions. Plan: reproduce in staging, increase cache size + run perf test with model v1.2 pinned. If that clears, propose config change for pilot. Will post results in ticket within 48h.
Priya (CS): will capture early feedback using this template in the weekly readout. Also creating a short enablement workbook for Karen's team (templates: prompts, guardrails, dashboard walkthrough). I'll drop the workbook link after kickoff.
Oncall Bot: reminder — kickoff meeting with Newport Health scheduled Mon 3/30 10:00 PST. Invite sent to Karen, Priya, Samir, Jordan, Ava.
Samir (Sales): thanks team — flagged renewal as "moderate risk" due to early perf concerns but upside if we stabilize and run enablement. Priya, please update renewal health after week 2.
Priya (CS): will do. I'll post a 2-week health summary and add follow-up tasks to the account playbook. :white_check_mark:
